digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, and Python strangler-fig
propositions: Bug provenance detection and trend queryability must be observable at creation without new required user input

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must exist for raw git writes, unread config fields, wall-clock assertions, unchecked AC checkboxes, code comment rot, and oversized bug-fix diffs lacking plan-review attestation
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflow, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig policy
Reconciler transport must be typed end-to-end with property-tested field asymmetries and deduplicated pagination loops
Canary and automation bug filing must follow hardened dedup pattern with documented bug-creation contract
Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-IDs, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI guards preventing regression
